rate_limits: Single-record: 5 RPS public / 10 RPS polite (concurrency 1 / 3). List/query requests: 1 RPS public / 3 RPS polite (concurrency 1 / 3). Limits in headers x-rate-limit-limit, x-rate-limit-interval, x-concurrency-limit, x-rate-limit-type; HTTP 429 when exceeded.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct; original outdated. Crossref publishes explicit REST limits (effective 2025-12-01; request-type split confirmed 2026-07-21): single-record 5 RPS public / 10 polite; list/query 1 RPS public / 3 polite; concurrency 1 public / 3 polite. Evidence: https://www.crossref.org/blog/announcing-changes-to-rest-api-rate-limits/ , https://www.crossref.org/documentation/retrieve-metadata/rest-api/access-and-authentication/ , https://community.crossref.org/t/refining-rest-api-limits-for-improved-stability-and-reliability/16137
